name: Mounting plate
description: A rounded plate with four mounting holes. A good first conversation.

hole_inset.label: Hole inset
hole_inset.description: Distance from each straight edge to the hole center.

print_notes: Print flat on the XY base, holes vertical. Default design: support-free FDM, PLA/PETG, 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layers. Verify screw fit with a test hole; no printer compensation is applied.
